title: Methods results and limitations
outcome: Explain methods results and limitations using the records and boundaries of this fictional investigation.
scenario: Separate procedure, finding and limit. A fictional report tests two frozen classifiers on five labelled leaf photos from one camera.
given: A is correct on 3/5; B on 4/5. No outdoor photos appear in the set.

steps.label: Identify the method
steps.detail: Same five photos, labels and scoring are used for both models.

steps.label: State the result
steps.detail: A scores 60%; B scores 80% on this fixed set.

steps.label: State the limit
steps.detail: The set supplies no outdoor-camera performance evidence.

explanation: Methods tell how evidence was produced; results state observations; limitations describe what those observations cannot settle. Keeping them distinct prevents a result from becoming an oversized claim.

counterfactual.change: The conclusion says B is best for outdoor farming.
counterfactual.prediction: Reject that extension without outdoor evidence.
counterfactual.reason: The reported conditions do not include the proposed use population.

student_task: Place the five-photo procedure, 3/5 versus 4/5 finding and missing outdoor evidence in their proper categories. Why cannot the result establish that B is best for outdoor farming?
teacher_answer: Same five photos, labels and scoring are used for both models. A scores 60%; B scores 80% on this fixed set. The set supplies no outdoor-camera performance evidence. Changed case: Reject that extension without outdoor evidence. The reported conditions do not include the proposed use population.
project_evidence: For the Reproducible AI Research Study, retain an annotated worked trace and the changed-case reasoning. Connect the claim to its records, units and assumptions so another investigator can challenge or reproduce it.
limits: Five observations cannot establish a stable ranking or causal mechanism; source and sampling assumptions remain important.
review_note: Individually authored fictional practice distinct from the reserved independent case. No invented significance, real experiment execution or pupil outcome is asserted.
